behaviorGuarantees: Manual move-measure-correct is absent from the menu and explicitly rejected by the Controller; move-measure never writes corrections
BulkApply selects valid new OK/direct/adopted/representative results across the current model independent of selection and filters; NG, masked, unmeasured and consumed results excluded
same Cell/Shot Beam siblings share one stored value; conflicting final values block the complete transaction
bulk calculation, lineage/Field/limit validation and one cumulative native write precede the engine commit; failed writes do not advance offsets or history
at most 11 logical states permit 10 Undo steps and Redo to the retained end; new writes after Undo truncate the Redo branch
history values, empty/initialized state and cursor survive validated sessions; changed frames and unverified external bases reset history rather than reuse unrelated values
same-frame file opening and return preserve a verified correction timeline while restoring the requested presentation; geometry mismatch falls back to the native baseline and preserves prior files
Undo/Redo write a new physical CSV; only a successful write moves the logical cursor; old-basis working measurements/proxies are invalidated and their consumption receipts retained
Simple/Rough/Fine and ReviewData One/All/Line Init distinguish absent values from a real measured zero; display uses empty/gray while arithmetic remains neutral zero
initial models without native rows seed empty history; the first correction can Undo back to absence; copied real zero into an empty target is saved as measurement-derived history
unmodified missing rows are not materialized as a fresh Init event, preserving unrelated fresh OK/NG; genuine zero applies create an actual measured-zero row
cross-panel per-row reset epochs clear pre-Init Rough/Fine eligibility and statistics, including inferred targets outside inspection lines, but preserve newer observations and unchanged epochs
Review tab navigation refreshes offset caches and current Rough/Fine Apply rechecks authoritative reset metadata before capturing deltas
historical result files remain; existing explicitly confirmed ReviewData historical reapplication policy is retained
Hardware/Default/First Beam/Distortion, coordinate arithmetic, device sequences, Config/Data and application themes are not changed
CSV/schema2 portable metadata, schema1 reading and exact Recovery archives retained; exported settings and scanner commands are reference-only, never executed
measurement deviation and cumulative B remain distinct; initialized/absent values do not become L1, while real measured zero retains a normal Level
no user read-only mode; editable current-frame reconnection and interlock/STOP guards retained
notExecuted: physical OS double-click/key injection or monitor DPI switch
